title: Your Throne, O God, Is Forever

questions.question: My heart overflows with a pleasing theme; I address my verses to the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:1 (ESV): "My heart overflows with a pleasing theme; I address my verses to the king;"

questions.question: My tongue is like the pen of a ready what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:1 (ESV): "my tongue is like the pen of a ready scribe."

questions.question: You are the most handsome of the sons of men; grace is poured upon your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:2 (ESV): "...grace is poured upon your lips;"

questions.question: Gird your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:3 (ESV): "Gird your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and majesty!"

questions.question: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:6 (ESV): "Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness;"

questions.question: You have loved righteousness and hated what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:7 (ESV): "You have loved righteousness and hated wickedness."

questions.question: Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:7 (ESV): "...has anointed you with the oil of gladness beyond your companions;"

questions.question: Your robes are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:8 (ESV): "your robes are all fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia."

questions.question: At your right hand stands the queen in gold of where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:9 (ESV): "...at your right hand stands the queen in gold of Ophir."

questions.question: Hear, O daughter, and consider, and incline your ear: forget your people and your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:10 (ESV): "...forget your people and your father's house,"

questions.question: In many robes she is led to the king, with her virgin companions following whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:14 (ESV): "In many robes she is led to the king, with her virgin companions following her."

questions.question: In place of your fathers shall be your sons; you will make them princes in all the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:16 (ESV): "...you will make them princes in all the earth."

questions.question: I will cause your name to be remembered in all generations; therefore nations will praise you when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:17 (ESV): "...therefore nations will praise you forever and ever."

questions.question: This Psalm is a love song. True or False?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45 Title: "To the choirmaster: according to Lilies. A Maskil of the Sons of Korah; a love song."

questions.question: Let your right hand teach you what kind of deeds?
questions.explanation: Psalm 45:4 (ESV): "...let your right hand teach you awesome deeds!"

key_verse_text: Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of your kingdom is a scepter of uprightness;
